courses.summary: 卡沙甘位於淺水北裏海並以人工島開發；本課以淺海地基、物流與地面處理界面做假想分析。本課依序分析人工島平均承載、島體差異沉降、淺海物流庫存緩衝、含硫介面檢驗證據、季節性補給等待，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Kashagan lies in the shallow North Caspian and uses artificial islands; teaching examines foundations, logistics and processing interfaces. The course analyses average bearing load on an artificial island, differential island settlement, inventory buffer for shallow-water logistics, inspection evidence for sour-service interfaces, seasonal supply waiting, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
